theorem_title: Exact shortcut iterate of a Mersenne-form start
natural_language_statement:
Let $T:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ be the shortcut Collatz map: $T(n)=n/2$ for even $n$ and $T(n)=(3n+1)/2$ for odd $n$. Write $T^k$ for its $k$-fold iterate, with $T^0(n)=n$.

For $h,q\in\mathbb N$ with $q>0$,

$$
T^h(2^h q-1)=3^h q-1.
$$

This is an exact finite-prefix identity. At $h=0$ subtraction is interpreted on natural numbers as in the source.
